title: M0 canonical file manifest
description: Canonical manifest of files in an M0 projection. Paths are posix (forward slash), case preserved, sorted by UTF-8 path bytes. gitMode is the git stage mode (100644/100755/120000/160000). sha256 is over the raw file content bytes. The projection hash is SHA-256 over the JCS-canonical bytes of this object (see tools/m0/jcs.mjs + hash.mjs).
